summary: FriendPlace Mini-CMS tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass covering auth (setup lockout, login, /me, forgot no-enumeration, reset-with-token), content GET/PATCH round-trip with public reflection, media upload/list/patch/delete + auth guards, public read endpoints, and the emergency CLI script (--list, --wipe safety). Frontend: full flow verified — /admin redirects to setup when DB empty, setup creates admin and lands on dashboard, setup route locks after first admin (redirects to /admin/login), sign-out clears token and blocks /admin/about behind login guard, login lands on dashboard, /admin/forgot always shows 'sent' message, /admin/faqs save round-trips to /api/public/faqs, /admin/media upload appears in grid with Copy URL button, /admin/about renders TipTap toolbar (Bold/Italic/H2/H3/List/Quote/Link/Image/undo/redo). One important behavioural finding: Pydantic EmailStr rejects the .local TLD suggested in the review request (admin@testcms.local), returning 422 'special-use or reserved name' — real users choosing internal-only email domains will hit the same wall. Test admin was wiped at the end so the user can create their own via the first-run flow.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr uses email-validator's default DNS-check rules and REJECTS reserved TLDs including .local, .test, .invalid, .example (returns 422 'special-use or reserved name'). The review request itself suggested admin@testcms.local which fails setup. If the user only owns an internal .local email, they cannot create an admin. Consider relaxing to a simple regex validator, or documenting that a routable public-TLD email is required.

issues: Tiny/blank images render as an empty grey square in the grid tile — no placeholder icon or 'preview unavailable' fallback. Not a bug for realistic uploads, but 0-KB or unreadable images give no visual feedback.

action_items: Decide how to handle reserved-TLD emails (.local, .test, .example, .invalid) — either swap EmailStr for a permissive validator, or update the CMS-README + the review-request test creds to a routable domain (e.g. admin@testcms.example.org still fails; only real-looking TLDs pass — I used admin@testcms.example.com in tests, which works).
critical_code_review_comments: cms_module.py imports server._DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT lazily inside two functions — works, but creates a soft coupling. Consider moving _DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT into a shared constants module to avoid the reverse import.

media/upload writes the file to disk BEFORE inserting the DB row (order is fine), but there is no cleanup if db.cms_media.insert_one fails mid-flight → orphaned files. Low probability, worth a try/except with unlink on failure.
GET /api/cms/media has no auth-scoped pagination or filtering beyond limit — fine for MVP with a small team, but flag for later.

cms_admin_reset.py: --wipe with --yes deletes ALL admins with no dry-run and no soft-delete/backup. Consider printing the list first and requiring the user to type the email as extra confirmation, but not required for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 critical flows: setup → dashboard, setup lockout, sign-out + auth guard, re-login, FAQ save + public reflection, media upload)

seed_data_creation: Test admin admin@testcms.example.com was created via the /admin/setup UI flow. It was WIPED at the end via `python /app/backend/scripts/cms_admin_reset.py --wipe --yes` so the user can run the first-run flow themselves. A couple of test FAQ rows remain in site_content (marker prefixes TEST_FAQ_* and UI_TEST_FAQ_*) — the user can overwrite them via /admin/faqs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CMS admin is currently wiped (cms_admins collection empty). Any future test run must call `python /app/backend/scripts/cms_admin_reset.py --wipe --yes` before starting AND use a routable-TLD email (NOT .local/.test/.invalid/.example — those hit Pydantic EmailStr rejection). Use admin@testcms.example.com + TestPass1234! for consistency. The pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_cms_module.py is self-contained and wipes/re-creates the admin as part of its module fixture — do not run it in parallel with UI tests.
rca_of_issue: The suggested test email admin@testcms.local returns 422 because Pydantic v2's EmailStr delegates to email-validator, which rejects RFC 6761 special-use / reserved TLDs (.local, .test, .invalid, .example, .localhost). Mitigation: (a) replace EmailStr with a looser custom validator in cms_module.py's CmsSetupIn/CmsLoginIn/CmsForgotIn models, or (b) update CMS-README.md to warn admins that internal-only .local mail domains won't work; use a real domain even in dev.
